problem.title: InTEn-LOAM KITTI 03: fixed missing-row support experiment
problem.question: Does completing missing S2S row support under the unchanged gate improve full-sequence odometry?

next_step: Review the uniform full-sequence experiment; repository extension stays default off.

variants.label: Fixed accelerated reference
variants.intent: Same inherited07-selected profile and acceleration in both arms; only missing-row completion differs. This repository extension is outside the paper and default off.
variants.note: InTEn-LOAM paper pipeline (FEF, S2S Alg. 1 with re-association, S2M Alg. 2 with TVF map, DOR gating map insertion); no GT seed. intensity=on mapping=on dor=on mean pairs s2s=904 s2m=1854 dor points/frame=32; repository acceleration enabled (opt-in, not in the paper); imported full paired experiment; timing is not a standalone speed measurement; actual argv in adjacent native_command.json
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: One candidate setting is evaluated across all sequences. No per-sequence adoption or default selection; the native option remains off.
